personalities.how: The shortest line to the next Badge. They can be raced.
Three a day, then stuck a day after any loss.
Two a day, toward whatever the team did last.
Two a day, by the book.
One a day. Two, from Badge 4.

reasons.says: They took Mr Onuoha's Growlithe. He's had it since before I was born.
My mum won't say what happened in the shop. She's started locking the door.
reasons.waits: Until Lean (slice 6), any loud job on the Hero's street

reasons.team: Ran a racket on the docks
reasons.says: My uncle's boat. He's paying somebody. He won't say who.
She taught me. She's not been the same since.
Somebody paid her. I don't believe it. I'm going to find out it's not true.
I don't get it. They're meant to be the bad ones. I want to ask.
There's a team. Nobody'll tell me what they want. I'm going to the League; they're in the way.
reasons.waits: Until each loud job has its own reason, it also stands for a loud job off the Hero's street

reasons.says: My brother's joined. He says there's dental.

reasons.team: Opened a Front on the street
reasons.says: There's a new café. Mum likes it. The man next door says don't go in. Nobody'll say why.
She's different. Happier. She won't tell me what happened; she says 'ask them.' So I'm going to.
My teacher's friends with them. Friends. Either she's wrong or everyone else is.
That's not her Gym any more. There's a stranger giving out Badges. I'm going to win it and then I'm going to get hers back.
The museum's shut. The thing I went to see every Saturday's gone. There's a mark on the wall where it was.
They've fenced off the ruin. I played there. Something's humming.
Two gangs. My street's in the middle. I don't care who started it.
They told everyone about Mr Baumgartner. It was true. That's what's wrong with it. Who are they to say?

words: Leads with it against anyone in the colours.
